 Football and basketball fans can cash in on a big night of sports with DraftKings Sportsbook . New customers can bet $5 and get $200 in Bonus Bets , plus receive three months of free NBA League Pass to keep up with the action on the hardwood.
 Thursday Night Football features the Chicago Bears and New England Patriots, with Caleb Williams and Drake Maye squaring off under the primetime lights. On the NBA side, LeBron James and the Philadelphia 76ers are facing his former team, the Cleveland Cavaliers, while the Denver Nuggets and reigning MVP Shai Gilgeous-Alexander's Oklahoma City Thunder headline the NBA slate tonight. 
 Get in on the action across both leagues with DraftKings. Bet $5 to get $200 in Bonus Bets and enjoy three months of free NBA League Pass to follow the rest of the season
   How to Sign up for DraftKings Sportsbook and Claim the New User Bonus
 Sign up for a new DraftKings Sportsbook account. 
 Enter all required information, including name, email and the last four digits of your Social Security number. 
 Agree to DraftKings' terms and conditions. 
 Make a deposit and opt in to the NBA League Pass promotion. 
 Make a wager of at least $5.
